caption: A door blown open by a draught swings until it reaches a magnetic doorstop, and the door snaps to the stop and holds open.

sa.check: A magnetic doorstop stands at the end of the door's travel, on the floor or wall.
The door reaches the stop and snaps onto it.
The door holds open on the stop.
No hand pushes the door: it swings as if blown.
The swing comes first, the snap onto the stop follows, and the hold comes last.

pc.expect: As the door nears the stop it closes the last gap onto it and comes to rest touching it.
pc.fail: The door reaches the stop and bounces back off it; or halts a gap short of the stop and hangs there; or swings on past where the stop stands; or rests held open with door and stop not touching.

pc.expect: Once on the stop the door stays held open for the rest of the clip; it does not drift or swing closed with nothing touching it.
pc.fail: The door swings back toward closed after coming to rest on the stop; or rocks open and shut on the stop; or jumps to a different angle between one moment and the next.

pc.expect: The door swings about its hinges as one panel, in one direction toward the stop, its free edge sweeping an arc.
pc.fail: The door reverses and swings toward closed before it has reached the stop; or the hinge side moves along the frame; or the door moves away from the frame as a whole.

pc.expect: The door is a rigid panel that keeps its flat shape through the swing; the stop stays fixed to the floor or wall as the door lands on it.
pc.fail: The door bends or ripples as it swings; or the stop slides across the floor when the door meets it; or the door's edge squashes against the stop.

pc.expect: One door on its hinges and one stop; the door passes through neither wall, furniture nor stop, and stays attached to its frame.
pc.fail: The door passes through the wall or a piece of furniture; or the stop vanishes or reappears in a new spot; or a second door appears; or the door detaches from its frame.

pc.expect: The door's colour and handle, the floor and the stop stay the same.
pc.fail: The door changes colour; or the handle changes side or shape; or the floor pattern changes.

note: The draught is invisible: the door beginning to swing with nothing visible pushing it is not a violation. What is judged is the arrival onto the stop and the door staying there.
